Commentary.Commentary: So, Afghanistan have a moderate target of 155 to win this one. South Africa need to be at the top of their game and bowl out of their skins if they are to win this match. What do we have in store? Join us in a while for Afghanistan's reply.

One of the few shining spots in the South African batting line-up today was Jonathan Bird who is caught down for a quick chat. On his injury, Bird says that there is no fracture but informs that there is serious pain on his left elbow. Says that this total is not good enough but they will try their best and look to get a couple of wickets up front and try to put the Afghanistan batters under pressure.

Another brilliant bowling performance from Afghanistan. They did it the first time when they met the hosts and they have managed to do it once again. Shafiqullah Ghafari was once again the tormentor-in-chief, and the Proteas did not have any clue which way he was turning the ball. From the two games against the hosts, Ghafari has scalped 10 wickets. Fazal Haque too had a very good day with the ball as he picked up wickets up top and put South Africa on the back foot early on. Abdul Rahman and Zohaib Ahmadzai were the other two to get into the wickets column with 2 and 1 respectively.

After opting to bat, South Africa's innings never got going as they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Jonathan Bird was going on superbly but he got injured and had to go off retired hurt. With the scorecard reading 91/7, it looked like South Africa will struggle to get to 150 but a 51-run stand between Mondli Khumalo and Merrick Brett took them close to 150. Bird came out at the end and his final flurry took the hosts above 150 and gave some respectability to the total.

A superb bowling performance from Afghanistan has seen them restrict the hosts to a total which is well under par. Once again, it is the spinners who have done the damage and brought about South Africa's downfall with the bat.

OUT! Caught! Bird holes out and South Africa are bowled out for a paltry score of 154. It is Shafiqullah Ghafari who puts the final nail in South Africa's innings. Tossed up on middle and off, Bird gets down on one knee and looks to slog sweep it over mid-wicket. He gets under it but does not time it well enough and the ball goes high in the air. Rahmanullah Khan sits under it and takes a good high catch. SOUTH AFRICA BOWLED OUT FOR 154!
Tossed up on off, Bird goes with hard hands and hits it straight to the bowler.
Tossed up ball outside off, tucked towards mid on.
Shafiqullah Ghafari is back. 8-3-15-3, his numbers so far.
Length ball on leg, Modimokoane looks to flick it but misses it to get hit on the thigh pad.
Short ball on middle and leg, Modimokoane ducks under it with ease.
Yorker on middle and leg, Modimokoane keeps it out at the last moment.
Length ball outside off, Bird lofts it towards mid off. The fielder there fumbles and allows a single.
On a good length and outside off, Bird plays it towards covers.
Length ball outside off, Bird drives it towards long on and gets to the other end.
Yes he can! Good length on off, Modimokoane defends it towards point.
On the hips, Bird turns it towards fine leg and gets to the other end. Can Modimokoane survive the last ball of the over?
Slower short ball, Bird looks to pull but misses. He thinks of a run but retracts from it.
Length ball on off, Jonathan punches it to cover.
FOUR! Now in front of square. Slightly shorter on off, Bird hangs on his back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The way he is batting it looks like he never hurt himself.
SIX! This is out of here! Bird has made that one fly well over the fence. Short ball on middle and off, Bird goes on his back foot and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a biggie.
Abdul Rahman is back on. 7-0-36-2 are his figures so far.
Length ball outside off, Modimokoane fails to get anything behind the ball as the ball goes past the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Odirile Modimokoane is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Length ball and outside off, Brett looks to go downtown but the ball swings away to take a thick outside edge on its way to the keeper. Mohammad Ishaq goes low to his right and grabs it inches above the ground. The Afghan players celebrate but the umpires converge and then after a discussion the umpire raises his finger to give Brett his marching orders.
Yorker on middle, Brett does well to keep it out.
Jonathan Bird is back to bat again. It will be interesting to see how that left elbow works. He was brilliant before that blow.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one goes down for South Africa and this time Haque strikes. Short of a length ball outside off by Haque, Khumalo looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it high and towards the man at point. Farhan Zakhil there settles under it and gobbles it up. Khumalo departs after a fighting knock and the 51-run stand is broken.
Length ball on off, played to point.

A run out chance missed! Khumalo tucks this length ball on leg towards mid-wicket and calls for a run. Khumalo sees the fielder and sends his partner back. Brett has to turn back and hurry up to make his ground. Luckily for him the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
SIX! Amazing shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Brett lofts it over long on for a maximum. 50-run stand is up between Brett and Khumalo.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Khumalo looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes safely towards covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Flighted delivery on off, Khumalo punches it to covers.
Loopy delivery on off, Mondli plays it to point.
Short delivery on middle, Khumalo pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up delivery on off, Khumalo punches it to point.
Jamshid Khan is back on. He has been excellent so far with figures of 4-1-4-0.
Length ball on off and middle, Brett looks to defend it. The ball bounces a bit extra and goes past the outside edge off the bat towards the keeper.
Short ball and on middle, Khumalo pulls it uppishly over mid-wicket. The ball is mopped up in the deep. The batsmen get a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings. Khumalo sees the length early and lofts it over mid off and finds the fence at long off for a boundary.
Good length ball outside off, Khumalo drives it towards covers.
Length ball and outside off, Khumalo fails to lay bat on ball.
Length and outside off, Khumalo looks to defend it but the ball swings away and beats the outside edge.
BEATEN! Tossed up on off, Brett looks to defend it but once again is beaten by the away spin.
Tossed up on off, Brett blocks it off the back foot.
Full and outside off, Brett goes for the reverse sweep but he misses it. There is an appeal from the bowler and the fielder but the umpire is unmoved.
Beauty! Tossed up on off, Brett looks to defend  it off the front foot. The ball spins away to beat the outside edge.
Tossed up and spinning away, Khumalo runs it down to third man for a single.
Full and on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket.

Drinks Break! Afghanistan are well on top. They are in pole position. South Africa have managed to get some respectability though. They still have Jonathan Bird who was retired hurt to come in but we are unsure whether he will be able to bat after copping up a nasty blow on his elbow. It will be interesting to see where South Africa end up after getting rocked by the Afghanistan spinners.
FOUR! Cheeky! Short ball and outside off, Brett just steers it over the point fielder and the ball bounces a couple of times on its way to the fence.

Short ball on middle and leg, Khumalo lets it be. The keeper leaps to take it but fails in his attempt. The ball rolls towards short fine leg. The keeper fields it from there but by then the batsmen take a single. Wide also given by the umpire.
Length ball outside off, Khumalo drives it towards mid off.
Khumalo looks to defend  this length ball to the off side but gets a bottom edge on it. The ball bounces past the stumps and the ball goes towards the keeper.
Fuller and on off, driven towards covers.
BEATEN! Length ball and outside off, Khumalo looks to go downtown but misses it and the ball goes past the outside edge.
Fuller in length and on middle, Brett brings his bat down late and just about manages to squeeze it towards square leg. A run taken.
Abdul Rahman is back on. 24/2 from his 5 overs so far.
Floated delivery on middle, Khumalo nudges it to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mondli keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Khumalo punches it to point.
Short delivery on middle, Khumalo pulls it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on off, Khumalo plays it to point.
Flighted delivery on middle, Khumalo keeps it out.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
WIDE! Ahmad bowls it down the leg side, Brett looks to flick but misses it.
Full delivery on off, Khumalo drives it through mid off for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Floated delivery on middle, Khumalo sweeps it through behind square leg for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on middle, Brett flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Brett looks to defend but misses it.
Tossed up delivery on off, Khumalo drives it through mid off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Good batting by Khumalo! He goes back, deep in his crease. Mondli opens the face of the bat and guides this one just wide of the fielder at short third man. The fielder gives it the chase and the batters take three runs.
Flatter one on off, played towards the man at point.
Flatter one outside off, Khumalo opens the face of the bat and guides this one towards short third man.
Flatter one on middle and off, Khumalo goes back and defends.

FOUR! Shouts of catch it but Ghafari has missed that! Floated delivery on middle and off, Khumalo smashes that low and straight towards Ghafari. Shafiqullah looks to get down and catch the ball but by then it has sneaked right between his legs and the ball races away to the long off fence.
Wide! Down the leg side, Khumalo looks to work this one fine down the leg side but misses.
Khumalo pushes this one down to long on and takes a single. 10 runs off the over. Good one for the South Africans.
Brett pushes this one down to long off for a single. Good cricket, taking a single after a big hit.
SIX! Brett has smashed that away! Floated on middle and off, Brett has slogged that over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. A much-needed one for the hosts.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed towards covers.
Another one tossed up around off, Khumalo pushes this one down the ground towards long off for one.
Floated on off, pushed down the ground towards long off for a single.
Shorter on off, Khmalo punches it back to the left of the bowler. Ghafari dives to his left and saves runs for his side.
WIDE! Ghafari misses his line and darts one down the leg side. Khumalo looks to flick but misses.

Oh! Almost the fourth for Ghafari. Tossed up on middle and leg, Khumalo looks to sweep but the ball kisses the inside edge and goes past the stumps fine down the leg side. He gets off the mark with a couple.
Shorter on off, Mondli manages to punch it to cover.
Floated on off, Khumalo blocks.
Shorter on off and middle, Khumalo manages to defend it late.
Mondli Khumalo is the new batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Another one bites the dust!  Shafiqullah gets his third of the game and the hosts have just not found a way to deal with him. Ghafari bowls it slower and a bit flatter on off, Cotani goes down on one knee and looks to go for a big slog sweep. There is just one man on the leg side in the deep and Khanya finds him to perfection. Sediqullah Atal there makes no mistake and Ghafari has 3 wickets for just 3 runs now.
Flighted and on middle and off, Brett blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Floated ball on off, blocked to the off side off the front foot.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven towards the man at mid off by the batsman.
FOUR! This time he gets it from the sweet part of the bat. Another tossed up ball on middle and leg, Brett slogs it through mid-wicket and fetches a boundary.
Brett takes the aerial route this time. Tossed up on off, Brett lofts it over mid on. There is not much power behind the shot. The ball lands safely at long on. The batsmen take a couple.
Full and wide outside off, Brett slaps it straight to covers.
Defended off the front foot by Cotani presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter one on off, defended towards point.
Cotani dances down the track and defends this ball onto the pitch.
Another one on the  pads, flicked towards the mid-wicket region.
Floated on middle and off, flicked towards the man at mid on.
Flatter one on off, defended towards the off side.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Brett blocks it off the front foot towards the off side.
Tossed up on off, Brett looks to defend it to the off side but the ball takes the outside edge and rolls towards the slip region.
Floated ball on off, Brett defends the ball off the front foot towards covers.
Full and on middle and leg, Cotani drives it towards mid on and takes a single.
Tossed up on off, Cotani defends it to point.
Flatter and outside off, Brett drives it to long off and takes a run.

Beaten! Missed the off pole by an inch! Another floated ball outside off, Cotani prods forward and looks to defend but the ball turns in and it sneaks through the bat and pad of Cotani to just about miss the off pole.

Floated delivery outside off, Cotani looks to come down the track and flick this one towards the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg but the Afghanistan players appeal for an LBW. The umpire quickly turns it down as the impact looks to be outside off.
This time no extravagant shots from Cotani as he prods forward and defends this loopy delivery.
Beaten! Ghafari again weaving his web! Floated delivery on off, Cotani goes for the reverse sweep but misses. The keeper looks to gather the ball but he too fumbles.
Flatter one outside off, Brett goes back and punches this one towards point and changes ends.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at long off for one.
Brett lunges forward to this tossed up ball on middle and leg. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards short fine leg.
Merrick Brett is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Van Vuuren departs in a similar fashion as his teammate Tyrese Karelse. Ahmadzai tosses one up on off, van Vuuren lunges forward and defends it. The ball later bounces and rolls towards the stumps. Karelse is a mere spectator as he fails to react despite having all the time in the world. The ball hits the stumps and the bails are dislodged. An unconvincing way to get out.
Another tossed up ball on off, van Vuuren is happy to block it off the back foot towards covers.
Flighted ball on off, van Vuuren defends it off the back foot.
Floated ball around off, Cotani drives it to long on for a single.
Full ball on off, Cotani blocks it to covers.
Flatter one on off, van Vuuren goes back and punches it towards the off side off the back foot. A maiden wicket over by Shafiqullah Ghafari.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards the man at mid on off the inner half of the bat.
Floated delivery on off, van Vuuren prods forward and defends.
Tiaan van Vuuren is the new batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! This time the stumps have been shattered as Beaufort has been bamboozled by Shafiqullah Ghafari. Shafiqullah bowls a beautiful loopy delivery outside off, it is the googly. Beaufort fails to pick it up. Beaufort looks to go for the defensive shot towards the off side but misses as he plays outside the line of the delivery. The ball sneaks through the bat and pad and dislodges the bails. Superb bowling by Ghafari and he is running through the South African middle order here.
On the pads of Beaufort, he flicks this one towards the leg side.
Ghafari starts with a flatter one on off, pushed towards the man at cover-point.
Tossed up around off, Cotani comes on the front foot and defends it onto the ground.
Another floated ball on off, Cotani blocks it off the front foot and towards mid on.
Tossed up on off, Cotani lunges forward and defends it to covers.

Floated and slower through the air on middle and leg. Beaufort looks to defend it back to the bowler. The ball spins in and takes the inside edge towards square leg. The batsmen get a single as the throw to the keeper was a wide one.
Tossed up on off, Beaufort defends it to covers off the front foot.
Full and angled on off, Beaufort drives it back to the bowler.
Zohaib Ahmadzai is into the attack.
Floated on middle, worked towards mid-wicket. Just a run and a wicket off the first over by Ghafari.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Cotani looks to defend but is beaten and hit on the thigh pad.
Khanya Cotani is the next batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED! The bail just about falls off and Karelse has to walk back to the pavilion after a good start. Ghafari strikes in  his very first over. Floated delivery around off, angling into Karelse. He looks to sweep but misses the ball. The ball goes on to hit his stomach and then rolls behind him to hit the stumps. The bail on top of the middle and off pole falls down and after a slight appeal by the Afghanistan players for LBW, they notice that the bail has come off and they start to celebrate.
This time it is flatter and outside off, Karelse plays this one towards point.
Change of angle for Ghafari, comes around the wicket, Karelse plays this one towards mid off.
Floated on off, Karelse looks to push this one towards the off side but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat down towards long on for a single.
Shafiqullah Ghafari is into the attack.
Floated ball around off, Beaufort drives it off the front foot through covers and the batsmen get a single.
Flighted delivery and on middle and leg, Karelse looks to tuck it to the leg side but the ball takes the inside edge and runs past the stumps towards fine leg. A run taken.
Tossed up ball around off, Karelse blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Flighted ball on off, Karelse pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Karelse drives it to covers.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up delivery on off, Beaufort lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Beaufort looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Loopy delivery on off, Beaufort punches it to point.
Full delivery on off, Karelse drives it through covers for a single.
WIDE! Ahmad bowls it down the leg side, Karelse looks to flick but misses it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Karelse punches it towards point.
Tossed up delivery on off, Beaufort defends it towards point for a single.
Floated on off, Karelse has punched that ball through the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Karelse shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, driven through covers for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Beaufort looks to defend it to the off side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes onto the pads.
Flighted on off, Beaufort drives it straight to mid off.
Floated on off, Karelse blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Tossed up outside off, Beaufort drives it through covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle and leg, Beaufort looks to tuck it to the leg side but the ball beats his shot and hits him high on the thigh pad.
Another one that is tossed up and Beaufort plays it off the front foot towards covers.
Tossed up on off, defended to covers off the front foot.
BEATEN! Ahmad slides one across the batter, Beaufort looks to get to the pitch of the ball but fails to do so. It goes past his outside edge and Beaufort is completely beaten.

Drinks Break! The hosts have lost three wickets and Tyrese Karelse and Luke Beaufort have done well to build on the innings. On the other hand, Afghanistan have kept it tight and will look to pick quick wickets to put pressure on South Africa.

BEATEN! Extra bounce there. Jamshid Khan tosses one up outside off, Karelse looks to push it towards the off side. The ball bounces a bit more than expected and whizzes past the outside edge. The keeper takes it superbly.
Flighted and on off, Karelse blocks it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Another tossed up ball around off, Karelse taps it to covers.
Flighted on off, Karelse plays it to covers off the front foot.
Floated on off, Karelse once again blocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around middle and off, Karelse defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery on off, Beaufort plays it towards point.
Another one on the pads, Karelse looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters sneak a leg bye.
Loopy delivery on middle, Beaufort looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
Full delivery on off, Beaufort drives it towards mid off.
FIVE WIDES! Ahmad bowls it down the leg side, Beaufort looks to flick but misses it. It goes past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Floated delivery on middle, Beaufort flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Short and outside off, Beaufort looks to cut but misses it.
Flatter and around off, Karelse taps it covers off the back foot.
Floated ball around off, Karelse comes on the front foot and smothers the spin on it.
Fuller and on off, Beaufort drives it through covers and gets to the other end.

Tossed up outside off, Beaufort comes on the front foot and looks to run it down to third man. However, the ball turns a long way and the ball sneaks past the outside edge and the keeper collects it by going low.
Flatter and outside off, Beaufort punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Flighted ball around off, Beaufort defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Jamshid Khan is on.
Floated once again around off, Karelse plays it back to the bowler.
Floated ball on off, Karelse blocks it off the back foot towards the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Karelse lets it be.
Tossed up ball outside off, Karelse looks to drive this one through covers but the ball spins away and sneaks past the outside edge.
Short and angling into the right-hander. Beaufort plays the pull and the ball rolls towards deep fine leg. The batsmen take three runs.
BEATEN! Tossed up ball on off, Beaufort looks to defend it but gets beaten on the poke. The keeper collects it.
Noor Ahmad is into the attack.

FOUR! Beautifully played! Short and wide outside off, Karelse cuts it powerfully through point and the ball races to the fence for a boundary. 12 runs come off the over and South Africa looking to get a move on.
WIDE! Length ball again way outside off, easy leave for Karelse.
WIDE! Length ball way outside off, Karelse lets it be. A wide given.
Length ball outside off, Beaufort guides it to third man for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, Beaufort looks to flick it but the ball bounces a bit and hits the thigh pad.
Another bouncer but not too high this time. Beaufort again lets it be.
Bumper outside off, it is way too high, Beaufort lets it be. The umpire gives it a wide.

FOUR! It's worth a treat to watch. South Africa are down but still they are going for boundaries. Haque bowls one on a length and outside off, Beaufort slaps it between cover and point and the fast outfield takes care that the ball reaches the fence.
Length ball outside off, Beaufort leaves this one alone.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, Afghanistan can have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Bouncer on middle and off, Karelse gets down and lets this one go. South Africa 44/3 at the end of Powerplay 1 with Jonathan Bird also retired hurt.
FOUR! What a shot to get off the mark by Karelse! A full ball outside off by Rahman, Karelse leans and slams this though the cover region for a wonderful boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, Karelse sways away from it.
Tyrese Karelse replaces him.

The physio is out. Bird is getting some attention on his elbow from the physio. He looks to be in serious pain here as the physio has a look at his left elbow. Magic spray is also applied but he is unable to move his arm. This is bad news for South Africa as Jonathan Bird is walking back.
Good length delivery on middle, Bird looks to nudge it towards the leg side but the ball has hit his left elbow. He looks in real pain and now he is down on his knees.
On a good length on off, Bird pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Full and outside off, Bird drives it through covers for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Beaufort plays it towards point.
Outside off, Luke shoulders arms to this one.
Full delivery outside off, Beaufort drives it towards mid off.
Length delivery on off, Beaufort taps it to point.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Beaufort looks to cut but misses it.
On a length on middle, Bird flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Luke Beaufort is the next batsman in. He is out to replace his skipper who was dismissed cheaply. South Africa in troubled waters.

OUT! Chopped on! Big wicket for Afghanistan as the South African skipper departs. He won't look back at that shot fondly. Rahman hits the deck hard outside off, it is away from the stumps. Parsons walks down the track a bit and then looks to punch it on the off side. He is a bit late in going for the shot. The ball comes quickly and takes an inside edge which goes on to uproot the middle and leg pole. The best batter of the series for the hosts is on his way back and Afghanistan are all over the hosts.
On a good length on off, Parsons offers a solid defense on this one.
Good length delivery on off, Parsons keeps it out.
FOUR! On a good length on off, Parsons looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes through point. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it but fails to do so. It races away to the fence.
On a length on middle, Parsons looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes just over the mid on fielder. The batsmen get two runs.
On a good length on off, Parsons keeps it out.

EDGED AND FOUR! On a good length on off, Bird looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards first slip where the fielder tries to stop it but it goes beneath him towards third man for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Bird defends it towards point.
Outside off, Bird does not bother to play at that.
FOUR! Pulled away with confidence and authority. Haque bangs it in short. Bird takes him on and goes on his back foot. He pulls it with disdain and fetches another boundary.
On a good length on off, Bird defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! That is put away! Short of a length delivery, Bird pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Bryce Parsons comes in to bat. The skipper has now the responsibility to sail the South African ship. He has been the lone warrior for the Proteas.

OUT! CAUGHT! Andrew Louw takes the long walk back and both the openers have been dismissed in quick time. Abdul Rahman bowls it on a good length outside off, Louw looks to fend at it but the ball shoots off the surface. It hits the splice of the bat and balloons towards gully where Shafiqullah Ghafari takes a comfortable catch.
On a good length on off, Bird defends it towards point for a single.
BEATEN! Good length delivery just outside off, Bird looks to poke at it but misses it.
On a length on middle, Louw flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery outside off, Louw drives it towards covers where the fielder tries to stop it but it goes beneath him for a boundary.
Bowls a bouncer outside off, Louw lets it sail through to the keeper.
Outside off, Bird shoulders arms to this one.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Bird looks to defend but misses it.
Full delivery on off, Bird drives it to point.
Length delivery on off, Bird punches it towards point.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Bird looks to follow the ball which is going away but luckily does not edge that.
On a length on middle, Louw flicks it towards mid-wicket. Fazal Haque himself runs to the ball, picks it and goes for a direct hit at the keeper's end but misses it. The batsmen take a run.
On off, Bird keeps it out.
On a good length on middle, Bird pushes it towards mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Bird defends it off the back foot.
Outside off, Bird offers no shot to this one.
Short delivery on off, Louw cuts it towards point for a single.
On a good length on off, Louw taps it to point.

FOUR! Good cricket all around. This is not a bad ball from Haque. He bowls it full and tries to take the ball away from there. Bird though is quick to get on his front foot and drives it straight down the ground, through mid off for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Bird drives it towards mid off.
BEATEN AGAIN! Good length delivery outside off, Bird looks to defend but misses it.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Bird looks to drive but misses it.
Good length delivery on middle, Bird looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Jonathan Bird is the new batsman in.

OUT! Caught! South Africa lose their first wicket and it is an early blow to them. Good bowling from the Afghanistan opening bowlers. They have been tight and built pressure which has provided the first breakthrough. Haque steams in and bowls it on a length around off. It is in the channel of uncertainity. Manje has a poke at it but the ball swings away a bit and takes the outside edge which goes low to the man at first slip. Rahmanullah Khan  there takes a good sharp catch. Those look easy on T.V. but they're never easy to take at slips.
Length delivery on off, Manje guides it towards third man for a single.
WIDE! Rahman bowls it wide outside off, Manje lets it go.
Outside off, Manje offers no shot to this one.
Full delivery on off, Manje drives it to covers where the fielder makes an excellent stop.
Good length delivery on off, Manje blocks it off the back foot.
On a good length and outside off, Manje shoulders arms to this one.
Full delivery on middle, Louw flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Abdul Rahman to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Full delivery outside off, Manje drives it to point.
Outside off, Manje offers no shot to this one.
BEATEN AGAIN! On a good length and outside off, Manje looks to defend but misses it.
BEATEN! Good length delivery just outside off, Manje looks to poke at it but misses it.
On a good length on off, Louw looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a single.

Afghanistan skipper, Farhan Zakhil says he is happy to bowl first. Tells that the bowlers bowled well and hopes that new day brings out the best of them. Informs that they have made one change to their side as Fazal Haque comes in for Imran Mir.

South African skipper, Bryce Parsons says that it is a good wicket and thinks that it will turn later on. On how he plans to deal with spin, Parsons says they are just looking to play to their best of abilities. Informs there are three changes in his side.

Toss - We are all in readiness for the toss. South African skipper, Bryce Parsons has the coin in hand. Up it goes, Afghanistan skipper, Farhan Zakhil calls tails but the coin has hit the feet of Parsons so the coin goes up again. Once again Farhan Zakhil calls Tails but it comes down as Heads. SOUTH AFRICA OPT TO BAT!

Pitch Report - HD Ackerman and Andy Flower are down with the pitch report. Ackerman says this is the same wicket where England played against Sri Lanka. Andy Flower says the pitch won't turn that much. Tells the pacers can extract some bounce off the surface.
